shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture, soft natural morning light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere: clothing, packaging, tags and objects are plain. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.safe_center: Keep the person, whole, inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.
shared_prompts.clear_view: The camera has a clear, unobstructed view from a few steps away at eye level: nothing stands between the camera and the person, and the face is fully visible and in sharp focus.
shared_prompts.kitchen: The setting is the grandparents' simple kitchen in Mexico on a bright morning: white walls, warm terracotta floor tiles, a sturdy wooden table, a window with green plants on the sill, all softly lit. The person sits alone at the wooden table, turned toward the camera, seen from the head to below the table edge, so the cup and what is on the table are large and clear.
shared_prompts.park: The setting is a wide gravel path beside a small lake in a green park on a bright, calm morning, with grass and trees softly out of focus behind. The camera is at chest height a few steps in front, and the runner is seen whole from head to running shoes. Running is the most obvious thing in the photo: a real, easy jogging stride toward the camera, one foot clearly off the ground, elbows bent, a relaxed smile.

assets.item: My grandmother always drinks tea. / She always drinks tea. / Who always drinks tea?

reference_file.observed_description: In front of the open green doors of a terracotta-orange house in Mexico, with the Mexican flag and pink bougainvillea at the left: Ana with her navy suitcase; her grandmother (about 80, white hair in a low bun, lavender blouse, long grey skirt); her grandfather (about 80, thin white hair, white short-sleeved shirt, brown trousers, wooden walking cane); and her young cousin in a mustard-yellow T-shirt.

assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Ana's grandparents, the very old white-haired couple in the green doorway.
